content.title: What Portland-area grocery stores are open Easter Sunday? Here’s a breakdown
content.text: Fear not, procrastinators. Most Portland-area grocery stores will be open for Easter this Sunday — some on regular hours and others on reduced holiday schedules. Easter is a Christian holiday observed on the first Sunday after the full moon that follows the spring equinox. This year, Easter falls on April 20.Here’s a roundup of which Portland-area stores will be open and closed for Easter. Are Fred Meyer and QFC stores open on Easter?The Kroger-owned stores will be open, but hours may vary by location and some pharmacies will be closed. You can check Fred Meyer hours here, and QFC hours here. Are Albertsons and Safeway open on Easter?Most stores owned by Albertsons will be open, but hours may vary by location. You can check Albertsons hours here, and Safeway hours here. Is WinCo open on Easter?Most WinCo stores will be open, but hours may vary by location. All 24-hour stores will remain open 24/7. You can check local hours here. Is New Seasons Market open on Easter?All New Seasons locations will be open regular hours, from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.Is Natural Grocers open on Easter?No. Is Zupan’s Markets open on Easter?All three Zupan’s Markets stores will be open regular hours, from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.Is World Foods open on Easter?The specialty market’s 9845 S.W. Barbur Blvd. location will be open from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. The Northwest Portland store, located at 830 N.W. Everett St., will be open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Is People’s Food Co-op open on Easter?People’s Food Co-op, located at 3029 S.E. 21st Ave., will be open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m.Is Alberta Co-op open on Easter?Alberta Co-op, which is at 1500 N.E. Alberta St., will be open from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.Is H Mart open on Easter?H Mart’s Portland store, located at 3301 S.E. Belmont St., will be open from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m. The Tigard store, at 13600 S.W. Pacific Highway, will be open from 9 a.m. to 9:30 p.m.Is Fubonn Supermarket open on Easter?Fubonn Supermarket, located at 2850 S.E. 82nd Ave., will be open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.Is Hồng Phát open on Easter?Hồng Phát Food Center, which is at 101 S.E. 82nd Ave., will be open from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. The Hồng Phát Supercenter, located at 4200 S.E. 82nd Ave., will be open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. The Northeast Portland market, located at 9819 N.E. Prescott St., will be open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. The Tigard store, at 11655 S.W. Pacific Highway, will also be open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. Is La Tapatia open on Easter?The family-owned supermarket has two locations in the Portland area. The Portland store, located at 18330 S.E. Stark St., will be open from 7:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.. The Gresham location, at 1025 E. Powell Blvd., will be open from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. Is Chuck’s Fresh Markets open on Easter? Both Vancouver locations will be open regular hours from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Is Market of Choice open on Easter?Market of Choice locations will be open, but store hours vary by location. Is U.S. Food Chef’s Store open on Easter? U.S. Food Chef’s Store will be open regular hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.Is Whole Foods open on Easter?Whole Foods, which has eight stores in the Portland area, will have adjusted hours of 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Sunday. Is Trader Joe’s open on Easter?Trader Joe’s, which has 13 stores in the Portland area, will be open regular hours from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. Is Grocery Outlet open on Easter?Some Grocery Outlet locations will be open, but the independently owned stores set their own hours, so shoppers should call ahead or doublecheck hours online.Are 7-Eleven, Plaid Pantry and convenience stores open on Easter?Most convenience stores are open 24/7, but some locations’ hours can vary. Is Walgreens open on Easter?Most Walgreens locations will be open, but hours may vary by location.Is CVS open on Easter?CVS will be open, but store and pharmacy hours may vary by location.Is Walmart open on Easter?Walmart, which has stores in Gresham, Clackamas, Washington and Clark counties, will be open regular hours.Is Target open on Easter?No. Is Costco open on Easter?
